recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future work should refine DeviceMetric.device wording directly if needed, not restore obsolete separate DeviceMetric.source and DeviceMetric.parent elements.
issue_request: FHIR-25240 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked to clarify the distinction between DeviceMetric.source and DeviceMetric.parent using PoCD containment guidance.
initial_application: No current-source commit explicitly titled FHIR-25240 was found. The relevant implementation trail includes 9a661e74e3, titled FHIR-39322, which removed DeviceMetric.source, renamed DeviceMetric.parent to DeviceMetric.device, and made the replacement reference mandatory.
additional_context: FHIR-40300 later published the concrete model decision to remove source, rename parent to device, and make the replacement 1..1. Confluence minutes and a Zulip devices thread connect FHIR-25240 to that same source/parent cleanup. Later FHIR-51443 and FHIR-53421 wording changes cleaned up DeviceMetric.device without reversing the model.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. DeviceMetric is active in source/fhir.ini, and the authoritative current StructureDefinition has DeviceMetric.device as a 1..1 Reference(Device) with text covering top-level versus component devices. The old source and parent names are absent from the resource definition and only remain as conversion mapping notes.
